evals.prompt:
Add Auth0 authentication to a Swift iOS application using the Auth0.swift SDK.

**Auth0 Credentials:**
- Domain: `dev-example.auth0.com`
- Client ID: `abc123def456ghi789jkl012`
evals.expected_output: Working iOS Swift app with Auth0 Web Auth login, secure Keychain credential storage via CredentialsManager, and proper Auth0.plist configuration
expectations: Auth0 SDK installed via any valid method (SPM URL, CocoaPods pod line, or Carthage)
Implements login via Auth0 WebAuth browser flow
Implements logout via clearSession (clears Auth0 session cookie)
Uses CredentialsManager for secure Keychain credential storage
Stores credentials in Keychain after login
Auth0 domain dev-example.auth0.com written to Auth0.plist config file
Client ID abc123def456ghi789jkl012 written to Auth0.plist config file
Does not use a SPA SDK instead of the native Auth0.swift SDK
No client_secret in native iOS/macOS app (PKCE does not require one)
Solution correctly integrates Auth0 into iOS Swift app with login, logout, secure credential storage, and Auth0.plist configuration
Pins the Auth0 SDK to an explicit version in the dependency declaration
Requests offline_access scope to enable refresh token issuance and silent token renewal
Configures biometric protection (Face ID / Touch ID) for credential retrieval
Handles Auth0-specific error types instead of generic catch-all
Solution contains at least 2 skill-specific advanced patterns (version, offline_access, SDK error types, or biometrics)

graders.description: Auth0 SDK installed via any valid method (SPM URL, CocoaPods pod line, or Carthage)
Implements login via Auth0 WebAuth browser flow
Implements logout — clearSession (Auth0.swift v2) or logout (v3 rename)
Uses CredentialsManager for secure Keychain credential storage
Stores credentials in Keychain after login
Auth0 domain written to Auth0.plist config file
Client ID written to Auth0.plist config file
Does not use a SPA SDK instead of the native Auth0.swift SDK
No client_secret in native iOS/macOS app (PKCE does not require one)
Solution correctly integrates Auth0 into Swift iOS app with login, logout, and secure credential storage
graders.question: Does the solution correctly integrate Auth0 into an iOS or macOS Swift app with: (1) working login via WebAuth browser flow, (2) logout that clears the session cookie, (3) secure credential storage using CredentialsManager (Keychain), and (4) proper Auth0.plist configuration with ClientId and Domain keys?
graders.examples:
PASS: Uses Auth0.webAuth().start() for login, .clearSession() for logout, CredentialsManager to store and retrieve credentials, and has Auth0.plist with ClientId and Domain.
FAIL: Only implements login without logout or credential storage.
FAIL: Stores tokens in UserDefaults instead of CredentialsManager.
FAIL: Uses @auth0/auth0-react or another web SDK instead of Auth0.swift.

graders.description: Requests offline_access scope to enable refresh token issuance and silent token renewal
Configures biometric protection (Face ID / Touch ID) for credential retrieval
Handles Auth0-specific error types instead of generic catch-all
Contains skill-specific advanced patterns beyond basic SDK usage (offline_access, error types, biometrics, version)
graders.question: Check ONLY for these skill-specific advanced patterns (NOT basic SDK usage like webAuth, clearSession, CredentialsManager, start, credentials, import Auth0). Look for at least 2 of: (1) an explicit pinned Auth0.swift version in a dependency declaration (Package.swift / CocoaPods / Carthage — any explicit version, not an open-ended range), (2) offline_access scope in a login call, (3) Auth0-specific error types (WebAuthError, CredentialsManagerError, AuthenticationError — not just generic catch), (4) biometric protection setup (enableBiometrics, LAPolicy). These are advanced patterns taught by the skill that are NOT part of standard quickstart knowledge. Answer YES only if at least 2 of these advanced patterns are present, NO otherwise.
graders.examples:
PASS: Login call includes offline_access scope AND code catches WebAuthError.userCancelled specifically.
PASS: Package declares an explicit Auth0.swift version AND credentialsManager.enableBiometrics(withTitle:) is called.
FAIL: Code only uses basic webAuth().start() with no offline_access, no SDK-specific error types, no biometrics.
FAIL: Code has correct basic structure but only catches generic Error, never the SDK-specific WebAuthError or CredentialsManagerError.
